summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Uonogamesapk.com APK store. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed covering public /api/apps, single app fetch, download redirect + counter increment, admin login (success/wrong-password/missing user), /auth/me (with/without/bad token), protected admin CRUD (401 without token, full create->get->update->get->delete->404 flow), and file upload (auth-protected, image round-trip via /api/uploads/{filename}). Frontend: Store page loads with hero banner, exactly 1 featured-main + 2 featured-secondary cards, 5 regular app cards, animated download counter renders. Search & category chips filter results. Download button opens the redirect URL in a new tab and shows success toast. Admin flow verified end-to-end: /admin without login redirects to /admin/login; login with admin@uonogamesapk.com / Admin@12345 lands on /admin dashboard; Add New App dialog creates an app (visible in list); Edit updates the name; Delete with confirmation removes it; Logout returns to /admin/login. JWT is stored in localStorage 'uono_token' and sent as Authorization: Bearer as designed.

integration_issues.issue: Search input and category chips only filter `data.apps` (regular list) — featured apps are excluded from results. E.g., searching 'Pixel' returns 0 cards because Pixel Racer X is featured. This is likely a UX bug: users expect search to match all apps including the pinned ones. Fix in Store.jsx: include featured in the filtered list, or hide featured only when search is empty AND category==='All'.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for {DialogContent}.' — add DialogDescription for accessibility.

Console error when a freshly created app has no icon_url: '' fires an empty-string src warning. In AdminDashboard.jsx list rendering, conditionally render the only when icon_url is non-empty (or default to placeholder).

action_items: Decide whether search and category filters should include featured apps. If yes, update Store.jsx filtered list to combine [...data.featured, ...data.apps] when a filter is active.
Fix empty-string warning by guarding icon rendering when icon_url is empty (Store AppCard, AdminDashboard row).
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Add/Edit App DialogContent for a11y compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes cookie-based and Bearer-based auth in get_current_admin. Frontend currently only uses Bearer/localStorage — cookie fallback is dead code but harmless. If cookies are not needed, remove for clarity.

GET /api/apps/{app_id} uses ObjectId(app_id) without try/except — a malformed id string will raise bson InvalidId and return a 500. Wrap in try/except and return 400/404. Same for /apps/{id}/download, PUT /admin/apps/{id}, DELETE /admin/apps/{id}.
POST /api/admin/apps returns a 200 (FastAPI default) instead of 201 Created for a resource creation endpoint. Not a blocker but not idiomatic REST.
seed() updates the admin password_hash when it changes, but does not update it when the same password is used with a corrupted hash. Acceptable as-is.
The Store `handleDownload` does an optimistic `downloads+1` bump on the client, which is correct — good UX.
No pagination on GET /api/apps (hard-coded 1000-doc cap). Fine for MVP scale.
resolveUrl in api.js correctly prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for relative /api/uploads paths.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all critical flows work; two minor UX/a11y observations)

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_-prefixed apps during CRUD flow and deletes them on the same test run; no orphan test data left behind. UI test created and then deleted TEST_UI_App.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is idempotent and safe to re-run. Frontend uses JWT in localStorage key 'uono_token' with Authorization: Bearer header (NOT httpOnly cookies). Featured section is rendered by /app/frontend/src/components/FeaturedApps.jsx with data-testids featured-main-{id} and featured-secondary-{id}. Search/category filter in Store.jsx currently operates only on data.apps (not data.featured), which yields 0 results for terms like 'Pixel' that only match featured apps — flag this if PM says search should include featured.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking issues. The 'search returns 0 for Pixel' observation RCA: Store.jsx uses `let list = data.apps;` for filtering and only renders `<FeaturedApps>` when `!search.trim() && category === 'All'`, so featured apps are effectively unsearchable. Reproduction: type 'Pixel' in search-input on / — empty state shown though Pixel Racer X exists. Mitigation: change filter source to `[...data.featured, ...data.apps]` when a search/category is active, or clear-featured-order on filter.
